messages:
alex: Hey team — hitting a weird combo of failures when using poetry + pip with the python SDK. CI shows httpx/anyio typing errors and install timeouts. anyone seen poetry lockfiles cause an aiohttp/httpx mismatch?

mira: Ugh yes. usually a transitive dep pins anyio or typing-extensions badly. quick Q — are you using the SDK from git or a wheel?

alex: Installing from our requirements (pyproject) + local editable SDK during dev. repro in a fresh venv: `poetry install` then `pytest` fails on import types. CI log attached.

jon: pinging @mira — also saw a failing integration with streaming endpoints where the async client returned sync iterators unexpectedly. might be related to version of httpx (0.23 vs 0.24).

mira: Two quick checks: 1) ensure `httpx>=0.23.0,<0.25.0` in your constraints so anyio/h11 stacks align. 2) make sure you don't have both `httpx[http2]` and a system `h2` binary weirdness.

alex: repro steps below if it helps — small snippet:```bash
python -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
poetry install --no-interaction
pytest -q
```

sam: Also check your environment for PYTHONPATH hacks. I ran into this where local editable SDK overshadowed installed wheel typing stubs.

mira: If the error mentions `typing_extensions.Protocol` vs `typing.Protocol` try adding `typing-extensions>=4.6.0` to pyproject tool.poetry.dependencies. Newer CPython backports change names.

alex: Adding typing-extensions fixed one error but now the streaming tests hang with "async generator not awaited". stacktrace shows our client: `async for chunk in client.stream(...):` never yields.

jon: That usually means sync httpx client being used by accident. Are you instantiating `RedwoodClient()` or `RedwoodAsyncClient()`? easy to slip.

alex: Ohhh good call — i had `from redwood import RedwoodClient` in a fixture. swapping to `RedwoodAsyncClient` made tests progress.

mira: For CI stability, we recommend: pin async client libs, add a small smoke test that does an actual async stream for 1s, and in poetry set `virtualenvs.create = true` in tox if using.

jon: I'm opening a tiny PR with a tox/env matrix and an explicit `httpx` constraint + `typing-extensions` bump. cc @alex for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1423

alex: Thanks! i'll test the PR branch locally. also, any suggestions for avoiding editable install shadowing typing stubs?

mira: Use `pip install -e .` less in CI; prefer building a wheel `python -m build` then `pip install dist/*.whl` in CI to mirror prod. For local dev, a `PYTHONPATH`-free workflow helps: rely on editable installs but keep stubs in package.

devx-bot: CI pipeline redwood-sdk-py #1423 — build succeeded :white_check_mark: — tests (smoke) passed on ubuntu-latest

sam: One last tip: add a tiny docs note in devex about "async vs sync client gotchas" and where the auth env var lives (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY_ASYNC) — there's been confusion.

mira: Agreed. i'll add a short reference in the SDK README and a dev checklist in the repo.

alex: Amazing, thanks all — resolved enough to continue. i'll post follow-up if CI still flakes. :thumbsup:
